historical_reviews.v3_1: Wistron I2C defaults to platform-management ownership, and ED-04 treats missing project-specific PSU route, target and expected-value bindings as readiness inputs when a bounded read-only plan can be defined.

original_test_intent: Validate the project-defined management-I2C/PMBus connectivity for the PSU board and populated supplies by confirming expected identity, status and telemetry responses without changing power control.
original_method: After the owner binds PSU-board/PSU identities, redundancy topology, BMC controller/mux path, safe read commands and expected values, collect non-mutating responses plus power, redundancy and platform-health evidence.
manual_activity: The power owner maps PSU_BD to each populated supply and redundancy channel, approves PMBus identity/status/telemetry reads and electrical recovery, and separately declares any physical inspection required by the project.
required_inputs: BMC/OOB controller, mux and PMBus route
Expected PSU addresses and device identities
Read-only PMBus command/register allowlist with units/scaling
Explicit exclusions for OPERATION, WRITE_PROTECT changes, CLEAR_FAULTS and vendor writes
safety_requirements: Do not infer removal, isolation or continuity measurement from PSU_BD
Do not scan unknown PMBus addresses
Do not issue OPERATION, margining, fan, fault-clear, write-protect or vendor write commands
Do not disrupt the active redundancy path or load
Preserve SEL and PSU fault history
Stop on supply loss, redundancy degradation, voltage/current anomaly, bus lock, thermal event or BMC reachability loss
agent_execution_scope: Verify PSU board, slots and redundancy topology
Validate BMC route and PMBus read allowlist
After approval, collect identity/status/telemetry only and correlate units with expected ranges
Monitor both supply and platform health
Perform no physical work, write, fault clear, power action or broad scan
engineer_actions: Bind PSU board, supply and rail identities
Approve read commands, scaling and expected ranges
Provide independent power recovery and any physical method

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command is supplied. The refusal to fabricate PMBus access is correct, but an unstated physical-continuity procedure cannot define the case. Safe logical evidence becomes feasible after exact power topology and read semantics are approved.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through the documented BMC/OOB PMBus path, issue only allowlisted identity, STATUS_* and telemetry reads for mapped PSU slots, preserving raw values, units, scaling, redundancy and platform-health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: PSU_BD, both TBD fields and two-minute planning metadata are retained; no slot, supply, address, PMBus command, limit or powered state is invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES PSU_BOARD PMBUS PACKAGE AND CONFIRMATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Fingerprint PSU/board/firmware and redundancy topology, capture baseline rails and faults, read only approved identity/status/telemetry through the mapped BMC route, compare scaled values with the project oracle, then confirm both redundancy and BMC/platform health remain stable.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Creates conditional logical coverage without rewriting the absent Master procedure or authorizing electrical/physical work.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: PMBus responses demonstrate the approved management path and telemetry only; they cannot prove connector mechanics or offline continuity if those become separate project requirements.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong PMBus command or route can change supply operation, clear diagnostic evidence, drop a rail or power off the platform.

project_override_considerations: A project may add an electrically isolated physical inspection, but it must remain a separate approved stage with qualified personnel. Logical PMBus collection is not permission for PSU handling or power cycling.
expected_evidence: Exact PSU_BD source and project applicability
Board/supply PN, revision, firmware, slot and rail mapping
Complete raw identity and STATUS_* responses
Scaled voltage/current/power/temperature values with units and limits
Before/after redundancy, SEL, BMC and platform power/thermal health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source is incomplete because both method and criteria are TBD, but contains no incompatible facts. Physical continuity exists only in the derived reviews.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The PSU-board management target, safe read-only PMBus operation class and required evidence are identifiable. Exact slot/route/commands/ranges are project inputs, so a deterministic plan can be formed under ED-04.

review_improvement: Preserves the power hazard while replacing an unsupported manual-only assumption with a PSU-slot and redundancy-aware PMBus read contract that explicitly excludes state-changing commands.
independent_technical_reasoning: PSU management buses often mix harmless telemetry with commands capable of margining, clearing faults or changing output state. The crucial boundary is therefore an exact read allowlist tied to physical PSU slots and redundancy—not a generic scan and not an invented continuity measurement. With those bindings and recovery, evidence collection is automatable but requires approval.
